actions.name: point_to_something
actions.text: a person raises one straight arm and holds it pointing forward or sideways
paraphrases: a person lifts the right arm straight out and holds it extended
a person extends the right arm away from the body and keeps it still
a person stretches one arm out level and briefly holds the pointing pose
actions.motion: The right arm rises from the side of the body and straightens at the elbow until the hand is far in front of or to the side of the shoulder, roughly at shoulder height. The arm is held still in that extended position for a moment while the torso and legs stay mostly still. The arm then lowers back to the side. The motion happens once and does not repeat.

phases.middle: right arm straight and held out at shoulder height

confusable_with.name: point_finger
confusable_with.visible_difference: point_finger has a second person standing where the arm points

confusable_with.name: taking_a_selfie
confusable_with.visible_difference: selfie arm is raised with the hand turned back toward the face and slightly bent

confusable_with.name: shoot_with_gun
confusable_with.visible_difference: shoot_with_gun often uses both hands together and has a partner reacting

actions.name: taking_a_selfie
actions.text: a person holds one hand up and out in front, facing the face
paraphrases: a person raises the right arm forward and up, hand aimed back at the head
a person lifts one hand above eye level in front and holds it there
a person extends the right arm up in front of the face and pauses
actions.motion: The right arm lifts forward and upward until the hand is in front of and slightly above the head, with the elbow partly bent. The hand stays still in that raised position for a while, sometimes with small adjustments, and the head may tilt slightly toward it. The torso stays upright with little leg motion. The arm then lowers back down.

phases.start: right arm lifts forward and up
phases.middle: hand held still in front of and above the face

confusable_with.name: point_to_something
confusable_with.visible_difference: pointing arm is fully straight and usually at shoulder height, not raised toward the face

confusable_with.name: play_with_phone_tablet
confusable_with.visible_difference: phone use keeps both hands low in front of the chest

confusable_with.name: take_a_photo
confusable_with.visible_difference: take_a_photo has two hands at the face and a second person in front

actions.name: check_time_(from_watch)
actions.text: a person lifts the left wrist in front of the chest and looks down
paraphrases: a person raises the left forearm horizontally in front of the body briefly
a person brings the left wrist up toward the face and holds it
a person bends the left elbow, lifts the wrist, and tilts the head down
actions.motion: The left forearm rises and turns so the wrist is held horizontally in front of the chest, with the elbow bent. The head tilts down slightly toward the raised wrist. The pose is held briefly, sometimes with the right hand touching the left wrist, then the left arm lowers back to the side. The action happens once.

phases.middle: wrist held level in front of chest, head tilted toward it

not_observable: eye gaze at the watch face

confusable_with.name: reading
confusable_with.visible_difference: reading keeps both hands together in front of the chest for longer

confusable_with.name: play_with_phone_tablet
confusable_with.visible_difference: phone use holds both hands low with small repeated finger-area motion

confusable_with.name: cross_hands_in_front
confusable_with.visible_difference: crossing hands moves both forearms into an X in front of the chest

actions.name: rub_two_hands
actions.text: a person rubs both hands together back and forth in front of chest
paraphrases: a person holds both palms together and slides them repeatedly against each other
a person keeps both hands touching in front of the body and moves them
a person brings the hands together at chest level and rubs them repeatedly
actions.motion: Both hands come together in front of the chest or stomach with the elbows bent. The hands stay in contact and slide back and forth against each other in short repeated strokes. The arms move only at the forearms while the torso and legs stay still. At the end the hands separate and lower.

phases.start: hands meet in front of chest
phases.middle: repeated small back-and-forth rubbing of the hands

not_observable: lotion or cold as a reason

confusable_with.name: clapping
confusable_with.visible_difference: clapping repeatedly moves the hands apart and back together

confusable_with.name: apply_cream_on_hand
confusable_with.visible_difference: cream application has one hand stroking over the back of the other with larger strokes

confusable_with.name: put_palms_together
confusable_with.visible_difference: palms together is held still with no rubbing motion

actions.name: nod_head_bow
actions.text: a person bends the head and upper body forward then straightens up
paraphrases: a person tips the head down and leans the torso forward briefly
a person bows by bending forward at the waist and returning upright
a person lowers the head toward the chest and then lifts it back
actions.motion: The head moves forward and down toward the chest, and in a bow the torso also leans forward from the hips. The arms stay mostly at the sides or hang down. After a short pause at the lowest point, the head and torso return to an upright posture. This may happen once or repeat a few times.

phases.middle: head and torso tilted forward and down

confusable_with.name: shake_head
confusable_with.visible_difference: shake_head turns the head side to side instead of down and up

confusable_with.name: nausea_vomiting
confusable_with.visible_difference: vomiting bends forward with a hand at the mouth or stomach and holds longer

confusable_with.name: pick_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: pick_up bends lower and one arm reaches toward the floor

actions.name: shake_head
actions.text: a person turns the head left and right repeatedly while the body stays still
paraphrases: a person rotates the head side to side several times with a still torso
a person moves the head repeatedly from left to right and back
a person swings the head from one side to the other a few times
actions.motion: The head rotates left and right around the neck several times in a row, while the shoulders and torso stay mostly still. The arms remain at the sides. The rotation is small and fast compared to whole-body turning. The head stops facing forward at the end.

confusable_with.name: nod_head_bow
confusable_with.visible_difference: nodding moves the head down and up rather than side to side

confusable_with.name: neck_pain
confusable_with.visible_difference: neck_pain has a hand held on the back of the neck

confusable_with.name: staggering
confusable_with.visible_difference: staggering sways the whole body and steps the feet

actions.name: wipe_face
actions.text: a person moves one or both hands over the face in wiping strokes
paraphrases: a person raises the hands to the face and strokes them across it
a person brings the hands up to the head and rubs down the face
a person lifts both hands to the face and moves them over it repeatedly
actions.motion: One or both hands rise from the sides to the face, with the elbows bent and raised in front of the chest. The hands stay at the face and move in up-down or side-to-side strokes, often more than once. The head may tilt slightly forward toward the hands. The hands then lower back down.

phases.middle: hands stroke across the face repeatedly

not_observable: sweat or water on the face

confusable_with.name: apply_cream_on_face
confusable_with.visible_difference: cream application uses fingertip strokes after first bringing the hands together

confusable_with.name: headache
confusable_with.visible_difference: headache holds a hand still on the forehead or temple

confusable_with.name: blow_nose
confusable_with.visible_difference: blow_nose keeps both hands fixed at the nose center

actions.name: salute
actions.text: a person raises the right hand to the forehead with the elbow out
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand to the brow and holds it briefly
a person bends the right arm so the hand touches near the forehead
a person brings the right hand up beside the head with the elbow sideways
actions.motion: The right arm lifts so that the elbow points out to the side at about shoulder height and the hand comes to rest near the right side of the forehead. The posture is held still for a moment with the body upright and the left arm at the side. The right arm then drops quickly back to the side.

phases.middle: right hand held at forehead, elbow out to side

confusable_with.name: headache
confusable_with.visible_difference: headache presses the hand on the head with the head tilted and the elbow lower

confusable_with.name: put_on_a_hat_cap
confusable_with.visible_difference: putting on a cap lifts the hand above the top of the head, often with both hands

confusable_with.name: flick_hair
confusable_with.visible_difference: flick_hair sweeps the hand back over the side of the head

actions.name: put_palms_together
actions.text: a person presses both palms together in front of the chest and holds
paraphrases: a person brings both hands together at the chest and keeps them still
a person joins the hands in front of the body and pauses
a person raises both hands to meet at chest level and holds the pose
actions.motion: Both hands rise from the sides and meet in front of the center of the chest, with the elbows bent and pointing outward or down. The hands stay pressed together without moving for a while. The head may bow slightly forward. Then the hands separate and lower to the sides.

phases.middle: hands joined and held still at chest center

confusable_with.name: rub_two_hands
confusable_with.visible_difference: rubbing moves the joined hands back and forth repeatedly

confusable_with.name: clapping
confusable_with.visible_difference: clapping separates and rejoins the hands rhythmically

confusable_with.name: cross_hands_in_front
confusable_with.visible_difference: crossed hands overlap at the wrists in an X instead of meeting palm to palm

actions.name: cross_hands_in_front
actions.text: a person crosses both forearms in an X shape in front of the chest
paraphrases: a person brings both arms across each other in front of the body
a person raises the forearms and overlaps them at the wrists in front
a person makes an X with both arms crossed in front of the torso
actions.motion: Both arms lift from the sides and the forearms cross each other in front of the chest or face, with each hand ending on the opposite side of the body. The crossed position is held still for a moment. The arms then uncross and lower back to the sides.

phases.middle: forearms crossed in an X and held

confusable_with.name: cross_arms
confusable_with.visible_difference: cross_arms folds the arms tight against the chest with hands tucked near the elbows

confusable_with.name: put_palms_together
confusable_with.visible_difference: palms together keeps both hands meeting at the center without crossing

confusable_with.name: check_time_(from_watch)
confusable_with.visible_difference: checking time lifts only the left forearm
